title: 健康与安全
summary: 评估公司工作场所健康安全管理，包括工伤事故率、安全培训与职业健康风险。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Health & Safety Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate's (MSCI S&C's) $^{1}$ outputs are determined. Health & Safety is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their management of workplace safety and the workplace safety standards in the industries and regions in which they operate.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍健康与安全关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）$^{1}$ 如何形成评估结果。健康与安全属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖工作场所安全管理，以及其运营所在行业与地区的工作场所安全标准。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“数据、评级与得分”章节。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Decreased operational efficiency, production disruptions.
blocks.content_cn: • 运营效率下降及生产中断。

blocks.content: \- Increased costs from litigation, penalties and fines.
blocks.content_cn: • 因诉讼、处罚和罚款而增加成本。

blocks.content: \- Loss of access to markets or growth opportunities from negative reputational effects.
blocks.content_cn: • 因负面声誉影响而丧失市场准入或增长机会。

sections.title_en: Health & Safety Key Issue score
sections.title_cn: 健康与安全关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Health & Safety Key Issue score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.
blocks.content_cn: 健康与安全关键议题得分评估公司对该议题风险的敞口程度及管理情况。该关键议题得分根据下述公式，基于风险敞口得分和管理得分计算。两项得分的结合方式意味着：风险敞口越高，公司就需要展现越强的管理能力，才能取得相同的总体关键议题得分。

MSCI S&C assigns each indicator a default weight. Indicator weights may be adjusted at the company level to reflect the relevance of the indicator to the company's business activities. If a company has no exposure to the business activities covered by an indicator, the indicator is assigned a weight of zero.

sections.title_en: Health & Safety Management score
sections.title_cn: 健康与安全管理得分

blocks.content: The Health & Safety Management score evaluates the company's ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicator, modified by controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 健康与安全管理得分评估公司管理该议题风险敞口的能力。它基于各相关指标得分的加权平均值计算，并根据争议事件进行调整。

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分来源于按0-10分制评分的指标，10分对应最佳实践。更多细节请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"风险管理分析"部分。除特别注明外，数据来源为公司披露。

blocks.content: The definitions of the data points in each component are given below:
blocks.content_cn: 各组成部分中数据点的定义如下：

sections.title_en: Health & Safety Governance & Strategy score
sections.title_cn: 健康与安全治理与战略得分

blocks.content: The Health & Safety Governance & Strategy score evaluates the company's initiatives to manage health and safety through governance structures, certifications, and comprehensive policy implementation. Highest initiatives reflect strong leadership accountability, certified management systems, regular audits, and consistent coverage of employees and contractors. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 健康与安全治理与战略得分评估公司通过治理架构、认证和全面政策实施来管理健康与安全的举措。最高水平的举措体现为明确的领导问责、经认证的管理体系、定期审计，以及对员工和承包商的一致覆盖。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: - Scope of health and safety policy
sections.title_cn: 健康与安全政策的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's health and safety policy applies to all operations or select operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司的健康与安全政策适用于全部运营还是选定运营。

sections.title_en: • Applicability of health and safety policy to contractors
sections.title_cn: • 健康与安全政策对承包商的适用性

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether contractors are held to the same health and safety policies as employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明承包商是否须遵守与员工相同的健康与安全政策。

sections.title_en: • Health and safety policy and practices are audited
sections.title_cn: • 健康与安全政策及实践接受审计

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company conducts internal and/or external audits of its health & safety policy and practices. This could include, for example, certification to ISO 45001 or a similar framework, which requires regular audits.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有证据证明公司对健康与安全政策及实践开展内部和／或外部审计。例如，取得 ISO 45001 或类似框架认证要求定期审计。

sections.title_en: • Health and safety performance is a factor in CEO compensation
sections.title_cn: • 健康与安全绩效纳入首席执行官薪酬考量

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether CEO compensation is linked to health and safety performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明首席执行官薪酬是否与健康与安全绩效挂钩。

sections.title_en: • Body responsible for health & safety strategy and performance
sections.title_cn: • 负责健康与安全战略及绩效的机构

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses whether the health & safety strategy and performance oversight is assigned to a dedicated individual, team, or committee. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating that the CEO is responsible for these practices.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估是否将健康与安全战略及绩效监督职责分配给专门个人、团队或委员会。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表由首席执行官负责这些实践。

sections.title_en: - CEO is responsible for health and safety strategy
sections.title_cn: • 首席执行官负责健康与安全战略

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's CEO has explicit responsibility for oversight of the company's health and safety strategy and performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司首席执行官是否明确负责监督健康与安全战略及绩效。

sections.title_en: - Senior executive or executive committee are responsible for health and safety strategy.
sections.title_cn: • 高级管理人员或执行委员会负责健康与安全战略。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is a senior executive or executive committee with explicit responsibility for oversight of the company's health and safety strategy and performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有高级管理人员或执行委员会明确负责监督公司健康与安全战略及绩效。

sections.title_en: - CSR or sustainability committees are responsible for health and safety strategy and performance
sections.title_cn: • 企业社会责任或可持续发展委员会负责健康与安全战略及绩效

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is a CSR or sustainability committee with explicit responsibility for oversight of the company's health and safety strategy and performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有企业社会责任或可持续发展委员会明确负责监督公司健康与安全战略及绩效。

blocks.content: ○ Non-executive or non-committee level task force is responsible for health and safety strategy and performance
blocks.content_cn: ○ 非高管人员或非委员会层面的工作组负责健康与安全战略及绩效

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is a non-executive person or non-committee with explicit responsibility for oversight of the company's health and safety strategy and performance. An example of this would be a non-executive risk officer that is responsible for these practices.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有非高管人员或非委员会机构明确负责监督公司健康与安全战略及绩效，例如负责相关实践的非高管层级风险负责人。

sections.title_en: • Evaluation of health & safety certification
sections.title_cn: • 健康与安全认证评估

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has obtained recognized health and safety certifications (e.g., ISO 45001). Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating the highest degree of certification.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司获得认可健康与安全认证（例如 ISO 45001）的程度。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高认证程度。

sections.title_en: - Evidence of health and safety management system certified to recognized standard
sections.title_cn: • 健康与安全管理体系取得认可标准认证的证据

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that some portion of the company's operations have a health and safety management system certified to the ISO 45001 standard, or GB/T 45001-2020 standard.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有证据证明公司部分运营的健康与安全管理体系已取得 ISO 45001 或 GB/T 45001-2020 标准认证。

sections.title_en: - Percentage of operations having health and safety management systems certified to recognized standard
sections.title_cn: • 健康与安全管理体系取得认可标准认证的运营比例

blocks.content: Definition: The percentage of operations that have a health and safety management system certified to the ISO 45001, or GB/T 45001 -2020 standard.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：健康与安全管理体系取得 ISO 45001 或 GB/T 45001-2020 标准认证的运营比例。

sections.title_en: • Contractors included in disclosed health and safety metrics
sections.title_cn: • 披露的健康与安全指标包含承包商

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether contractor health and safety performance is measured and disclosed in the same or similar manner as employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明承包商健康与安全绩效是否以与员工相同或相似的方式衡量和披露。

sections.title_en: Health & Safety Targets score
sections.title_cn: 健康与安全目标得分

blocks.content: The Health & Safety Targets score evaluates the company's initiatives to set targets for improving health and safety performance, including accident and fatality reduction goals that cover both employees and contractors. Highest initiatives reflect quantifiable, non-zero reduction targets with clear accountability. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 健康与安全目标得分评估公司制定改善相关绩效目标的举措，包括同时覆盖员工和承包商的事故及死亡减少目标。最高水平的举措体现为可量化、非零的削减目标，以及明确问责。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Target to improve health and safety performance
sections.title_cn: • 改善健康与安全绩效的目标

blocks.content: Definition: The type of target set by the company to reduce employee accidents and fatalities. Best practice is to set a quantifiable (non-zero) accident reduction target that includes contractors and employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司为减少员工事故及死亡而设定的目标类型。最佳实践是设定同时覆盖承包商和员工的可量化、非零事故削减目标。

sections.title_en: Health & Safety Performance score
sections.title_cn: 健康与安全绩效得分

blocks.content: The Health & Safety Performance score evaluates the company's performance on health and safety metrics (including lost time incident rate, total recordable injury rate, and fatalities), relative to its peers. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 健康与安全绩效得分评估公司相关指标相对于同行的表现，包括损失工时事故率、可记录工伤总发生率及死亡事故。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示最高绩效水平。

blocks.content: The following provides a non-exhaustive overview of the data points used in the assessment of the Health & Safety Performance score.
blocks.content_cn: 以下对健康与安全绩效得分评估所使用的数据点作非穷尽性概述。

sections.title_en: - Lost time incident rate performance relative to peers
sections.title_cn: 相对于同行的损失工时事故率表现

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on reported lost time incidents rate [LTIR] (per million hours worked), and trend in LTIR, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司报告的每百万工时损失工时事故率及其变化趋势相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: - Lost time incident rate (per million hours worked) industry relative score
sections.title_cn: • 损失工时事故率行业相对得分（每百万工时）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on Lost Time Incident Rate (number of incidents resulting in lost work time per million hours worked) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司损失工时事故率，即每百万工时造成工时损失的事故数量，相对于行业同业的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: ■ Three-year average Lost time incident rate (per million hours worked)
sections.title_cn: ■ 三年平均损失工时事故率（每百万工时）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company's three-year average Lost Time Incident Rate (per million hours worked).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司每百万工时损失工时事故率的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: - Lost time incident rate (per million hours worked) industry relative trend score
sections.title_cn: • 损失工时事故率趋势行业相对得分（每百万工时）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on the three-year average of year-over-year Lost Time Incident Rate (per million hours worked) trend, relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司每百万工时损失工时事故率同比变化趋势的三年平均值相对于行业同业的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: ■ Three-year average Lost time incident rate trend (per million hours worked)
sections.title_cn: ■ 损失工时事故率趋势的三年平均值（每百万工时）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company's three-year average of year-over-year Lost Time Incident Rate (per million hours worked) trend.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司每百万工时损失工时事故率同比变化趋势的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: • Total recordable injury rate performance relative to peers
sections.title_cn: • 相对于同行的可记录工伤总发生率表现

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on reported total recordable injury rate [TRIR] (per million hours worked), and trend in TRIR, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司报告的每百万工时可记录工伤总发生率及其变化趋势相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: - Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) industry relative score
sections.title_cn: • 可记录工伤总发生率行业相对得分（每百万工时）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on Total Recordable Injury Rate (number of recordable injuries per million hours worked), relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司可记录工伤总发生率，即每百万工时可记录工伤数量，相对于行业同业的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: ■ Three-year average Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked)
sections.title_cn: ■ 三年平均可记录工伤总发生率（每百万工时）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company's three-year average Total Recordable Injury Rate (per million hours worked).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司每百万工时可记录工伤总发生率的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: - Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) industry relative trend score
sections.title_cn: • 可记录工伤总发生率趋势行业相对得分（每百万工时）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on the three-year average of year-over-year Total Recordable Injury Rate (per million hours worked) trend, relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司每百万工时可记录工伤总发生率同比变化趋势的三年平均值相对于行业同业的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: - Three-year average Total recordable injury rate trend (per million hours worked)
sections.title_cn: • 可记录工伤总发生率趋势的三年平均值（每百万工时）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company's three-year average of year-over-year Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) trend.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司每百万工时可记录工伤总发生率同比变化趋势的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: • Fatality intensity performance relative to peers
sections.title_cn: • 相对于同行的死亡事故强度表现

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on fatalities intensity (normalized by number of employees and/or by sales), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating zero fatalities.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司死亡事故强度（按员工人数和／或销售额标准化）相对于行业同业的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表零死亡。

sections.title_en: - Fatalities industry relative score
sections.title_cn: • 死亡事故行业相对得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on fatalities normalized per 100,000 employees and/or sales, relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司死亡人数按每 100,000 名员工和／或销售额标准化后，相对于行业同业的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: ■ Three-year average fatalities (per 100,000 employees)
sections.title_cn: ■ 三年平均死亡人数（每 100,000 名员工）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company's three-year average fatalities per 100,000 employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司每 100,000 名员工死亡人数的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: ■ Three-year average fatalities per million USD in sales
sections.title_cn: ■ 每百万美元销售额死亡人数的三年平均值

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company's three-year average fatalities per million USD in sales.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司每百万美元销售额死亡人数的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: Controversies
sections.title_cn: 争议事件

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management score based on the severity, status, and the company's role in the controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The result is the Management score. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度、状态及公司角色，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分，得到管理得分。评估采用以下争议类别：

blocks.content: • Health and safety controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 健康与安全争议。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to the Controversies cases section of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“争议案例”章节。

sections.title_en: Health & Safety Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 健康与安全风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Health & Safety Exposure score evaluates the company's exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure scores. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to the Analyzing risk exposure section of "ESG Ratings Methodology" for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 健康与安全风险敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的风险敞口，以业务和地域风险敞口得分为基础。地域风险敞口得分作为业务风险敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。业务与地域风险敞口得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高风险，0 分对应最低风险。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“风险敞口分析”章节。风险敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ {H E S, i} = B U S _ {H E S, i} (1 + 0. 1 \bigl (G E O _ {H E S, i} - 5 \bigr))
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{HES,i}$ is the Health & Safety Exposure score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{HES,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的健康与安全风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $BUS_{HES,i}$ is the Business Exposure score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BUS_{HES,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $GEO_{HES,i}$ is the Geographic Exposure score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $GEO_{HES,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的地域风险敞口得分。

sections.title_cn: 业务敞口得分

sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure scores
sections.title_cn: 业务板块敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by a simple average of the Accident Rate score of the segment and the Fatality Rate score of the segment:
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。各业务活动得分由该分部事故率得分与死亡率得分的简单平均值确定：

blocks.content: \- $BSE_{HES,j}$ is the Business Exposure score for business segment $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BSE_{HES,j}$ 为业务分部 $j$ 的业务风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $AR_{j}$ is the Accident Rate score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $AR_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的事故率得分。

blocks.content: \- $FR_{j}$ is the Fatality Rate score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $FR_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的死亡率得分。

blocks.content: The Accident Rate score of a business activity is the average of accident rates reported in the United States by the Occupational Safety & Health Administration (OSHA) and accident rates reported in the United Kingdom under the Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (RIDDOR) at a business activity level.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动事故率得分，是美国职业安全与健康管理局报告的事故率，与英国依据《伤害、疾病和危险事件报告条例》报告的事故率，在业务活动层面的平均值。

blocks.content: The Fatality Rate score of a business activity is the average of fatality rates reported in the United States by OSHA and fatality rates reported in the United Kingdom by RIDDOR at a business activity level.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动死亡率得分，是美国职业安全与健康管理局报告的死亡率，与英国依据《伤害、疾病和危险事件报告条例》报告的死亡率，在业务活动层面的平均值。

blocks.content: If there is no data reported by the ILO for a country, a default score of 6.7 is used to classify the country or market at the lower end of the high-risk band. We assume countries that do not report workplace injuries and fatalities carry high risk.
blocks.content_cn: 若国际劳工组织未报告某国数据，则采用默认得分 6.7，将该国家或市场归入高风险区间的较低端。模型假设不报告工作场所伤害和死亡事故的国家风险较高。
